newsitem.title: UK: UK machine tools turnover rises in 3mths to Feb.
newsitem.headline: UK machine tools turnover rises in 3mths to Feb.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics said turnover of machine tools increase by 8.7 percent in the three months to February compared with the previous three months.
This was due to a 15.6 percent rise in export turnover, and a 4.7 percent rise in home turnover.
Compared to the same period a year ago, total turnover of machine tools rose by 5.5 percent.
Total orders on hand for machine tools at the end of February 1997 fell 1.4 percent fall compared with the end of November 1996, but were up 15.1 percent on February 1996.
